label: Finite controls for q44 ancestor-to-source supply
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Seven explicit finite controls over three beings. The first two separate participant actuality from represented esse-essence distinction. The next four omit causal composition, the unreceived-to-own-being interpretation, the selected identity witness and identity uniqueness, respectively. All retain the common-ancestor facts and the other displayed inputs. The positive model supplies a participant source, exercises causal composition along a two-link esse chain, and makes every other being CREATURE_1. Facts about the encoded interpretations only, without metaphysical possibility or premise-refutation claims.
